answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the atlas of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the marble of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
